fields.explanation: PAN application type — Changes or Correction in existing PAN Data / Reprint of PAN Card. Must be filled first: NSDL only unhides the citizenship + PAN Number row (#rowCR) once this select fires change with CR.
Applicant category — Individual. Filled after application_type because NSDL's #type change handler rewrites this dropdown's options; 1s delay lets that finish before the name fields.
Your first name as per your existing PAN.

fields.skip_reason: You don't have a middle name, so there's nothing to fill.
fields.explanation: Your middle name as per your existing PAN.
Your last name as per your existing PAN.
Your date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format.
Your email — your corrected ePAN will be sent here.
Your 10-digit mobile number.
Whether Citizen of India — Yes. Only visible after application_type is set to CR.
Consent to data processing.

completion.title: Registration filled!
completion.subtitle: Enter your PAN number, then generate your token
manual_steps: Type your existing 10-character PAN number in the PAN NUMBER box
Solve the CAPTCHA and wait for the green check ✓
completion.info: Your token will appear on the next screen.

page_coach.message: Enter your PAN number, solve the CAPTCHA, wait for the green check ✓, then click Submit

steps.stop_message: Token generated. Clicking Continue to proceed.

fields.explanation: Continue past the token confirmation screen.

steps.stop_message: Existing application found. Selecting your previous token.

fields.explanation: Select existing token to resume previous application. NSDL's inline onclick enables the Use-above-Token button, which starts disabled.
Click Use above Token to proceed.

steps.stop_message: Personal details filled. Please verify and click Next.

fields.explanation: Submit scanned images through e-Sign — used instead of Aadhaar-based eKYC so the applicant's own current address can be filled in and corrected (eKYC forces the Aadhaar address and disables the Address / Proof-of-Identity / Proof-of-Address sections).
e-Sign vendor — Protean (e-Sign Charges Rs. 5.90). The dropdown is disabled until the scanned-images radio is selected; the delay lets the site's JS enable it first.

fields.skip_reason: You chose ePAN only, so this option is left unselected.
fields.explanation: Physical PAN card + ePAN (₹101).

fields.skip_reason: You chose to receive a physical card, so this option is left unselected.
fields.explanation: ePAN only, no physical card (₹66). Email becomes mandatory.
Correction form only: the tick beside a section heading marks that section for change. Without it NSDL ignores whatever is typed below.
Last 4 digits of your Aadhaar — the first 8 are masked and read-only.
Consent to print your Aadhaar photo on the PAN card.

EID section tick, right after the Aadhaar digits. Its label and the EID number input are both commented out on this page — no field ever appears and no site JS reacts to it — so ticking it is inert; left it checked to match every other section's checkbox.

Name exactly as printed on Aadhaar, as typed by the applicant in the panel. Assembled from the split name fields only for drafts saved before that field existed. eKYC pulls this from Aadhaar directly and disables the field; under scanned-images e-Sign it's blank and required, and the site's own JS never re-enables it after disabling it on page load, so we force it enabled here.
Marks Full Name of the Applicant for change.
First name as per Aadhaar.

fields.skip_reason: You don't have a middle name, so there's nothing to fill.
fields.explanation: Middle name as per Aadhaar.
Last name as per Aadhaar.
Marks Date of Birth for change. The date itself is read-only here — it carries over from the token registration.
Marks Gender for change.
Your gender as per Aadhaar.
Marks Details of Parents for change. The single-parent radio inside this section is server-populated from the existing PAN, so it is deliberately not filled.

fields.skip_reason: You didn't provide your father's details, and they aren't required for your PAN.
fields.explanation: Father's first name.

fields.skip_reason: No middle name given for your father.
fields.explanation: Father's middle name.

fields.skip_reason: You didn't provide your father's details, and they aren't required for your PAN.
fields.explanation: Father's last name.

fields.skip_reason: You didn't provide your mother's details, and they aren't required for your PAN.
fields.explanation: Mother's first name.

fields.skip_reason: No middle name given for your mother.
fields.explanation: Mother's middle name.

fields.skip_reason: You didn't provide your mother's details, and they aren't required for your PAN.
fields.explanation: Mother's last name.

fields.skip_reason: You chose your mother's name to appear on the card.
fields.explanation: Print father's name on the PAN card.

fields.skip_reason: You chose your father's name to appear on the card.
fields.explanation: Print mother's name on the PAN card.

steps.stop_message: Contact details filled. Please verify and click Next.

fields.explanation: Address for communication — Residence (default; individual applicants almost always choose this).
Flat/Door/Building of your current residence address.
Road/Street/Block/Sector of your current residence address.

fields.skip_reason: Post Office is optional; left blank since you didn't provide one.
fields.explanation: Post office of your current residence address.
Area/Locality/Town/City of your current residence address.
District of your current residence address.
Country — India. Delay lets the site's AJAX call repopulate the State dropdown before we select a state.
State/Union Territory of your current residence address.
PIN code of your current residence address.
Marks Contact Details for change. Must be ticked before the fields below are accepted.
Country code for the mobile number — India (91).
Your 10-digit mobile number.

fields.skip_reason: Only needed if you're a non-resident. Not required for your PAN.
fields.explanation: Passport number — mandatory only for non-residents and residents not ordinarily resident. Left blank when the applicant hasn't given one.

fields.skip_reason: Only needed if you pay tax in another country. Not required for your PAN.
fields.explanation: Taxpayer Identification Number in the country of residence — mandatory only for foreign applicants. Left blank when the applicant hasn't given one.

steps.stop_message: Declaration filled & saved. Now upload your documents.

fields.explanation: Proof of identity — as selected in the panel. Needed because scanned-images e-Sign (unlike eKYC) doesn't auto-set this to Aadhaar and disable it.
Proof of address — for your current address, as selected in the panel.
Proof of date of birth — the document the applicant picked in the panel.
Proof of PAN — Copy of Pan Card, Copy of Pan Allotment Letter, or No Document. Correction-form only field.
The "I/We ___, the applicant" name in the declaration.
Declaration capacity — Self.
City where the application is being filed. The date beside it is read-only and set by the page.
Save Draft — preserves every filled field before the applicant uploads documents. Saves only; it does not submit the application.

completion.title: Details filled & saved!
completion.subtitle: Now upload your documents below
manual_steps: Upload your proof of date of birth, proof of identity, and proof of address
Enter the number of documents you attached in the declaration — we leave this blank since we can't know it until you've uploaded
